name: How much does basement flooring installation cost in the Denver area?

mainEntity.name: How much does basement flooring installation cost in the Denver area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost depends on the square footage, material, and how much prep the concrete needs. Waterproof LVP is often a budget-friendly middle ground for basements, while tile and custom concrete finishes can cost more; hidden slab repairs can also raise the total.
acceptedAnswer.description: Price depends on size, material, and slab prep. Waterproof LVP is often the best value for basements, while extensive leveling or moisture fixes can increase the total.
